calibration.selectionRule: Embed the byte-exact phone and desktop raw-capsule sample objects from three independent one-attempt candidate runs (20260820-arc1a-serviced-turn-candidate5, 20260820-arc1a-serviced-turn-candidate6, and 20260820-arc1a-serviced-turn-candidate7) plus paired baseline run 20260820-arc1a-serviced-turn-baseline4. Reduce every embedded raw capsule rather than trusting copied metrics, faults, or outcome rows. All evidence uses exact isolated Edg/151.0.4129.86, revision @083e754915c9ab93da1d8f7b9c860e4520273900, JavaScript 15.1.23.7, protocol 1.3, measurement authority bb03a3af59cdcc9d4d3773c1396e58b350c27facd99943cbd22028f2236d6a1c, producer authority 1c8200d7a5ab71341be0f808c242f250b529a3ead4c8cf551cbdf99bebd405c2, and candidate/collector commit f47cd381699fb1934f30bfca82fc9bf971714e6d. For every profile and field choose a ceiling strictly above the observed three-run maximum, with fractional or +1 sentinels below the next reachable integer or 132px resource quantum for product-owned exact caps and documented rational headroom for variable heap, DOM, encoded-byte, and warm-range fields; require the paired baseline to retain all four sealed faults and multiple ceiling breaches. This Arc-local Edge authority does not re-pin the Gate-A/global browser.
